ignore_patterns: INSURANCE REGULATORY AND DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY OF INDIA
// small_type: This gazette sets its Hindi half at 11.25pt and its ENGLISH half at 9.36pt, under the 9.5 default below which a line is read as a footnote — so the entire English document dropped and produced 0 clauses.
// section: No chapters — a flat 1..19. Regulation heads sit at x0=76.7 (and 59.8 for the one two-digit outlier), but so does BODY text, so x0 cannot be the discriminator here; the numbered-head pattern is. max_x0 78 only keeps deeper sub-items (93-115) from opening clauses.
// form_starts: From FORM I-A onward the document is application forms and an annexure, whose notes restart at '1.', '2.' at the SAME x0 as the regulations — without this they would be segmented as regulations 1..6 all over again, colliding with the real ones. Suspending section splitting folds the forms into the last regulation as body.
